capabilities: Render goban diagrams from fenced code blocks
Output SVG board images in note preview
extras: README states the plugin is very experimental with limited customization options and links to external documentation for the full diagram syntax.
problem: Obsidian cannot display Go board position diagrams written in Sensei's Library notation, so players have no way to visualize positions in notes.

relations.evidence: uses a renderer derived from an older Sensei's Library diagram conversion script

summary: Renders Go/Baduk/Weiqi board diagrams from Sensei's Library notation inside fenced goban code blocks as SVG images.
